Name: Pet Can Have Backpack
Author: ailicili1111
Description:
鸭科夫的小狗来到了茅台镇！宠物现在可以右键互动打开背包。搭配我另一个Mod 让宠物跟随你不然宠物只能在农场里当一个移动箱子了。
背包初始9格，在皮埃尔商店升级，和老农民一个价钱。 

可搭配其他宠物皮肤Mod, 如果有其他皮肤Mod和本Mod不能同时生效，可以在评论区让我更新

Duckov pet system is now in Pelican town. Right click to interact and open the pet backpack. Use with my other mod that makes pet follow you, or it will just sit at farm like normal and now its just a cat/dog looking chest. Pet's default backpack is 9 slots, upgrade at Pierre's shop, same price as the farmer backpack.

Compatible with pet skins, if there are any skin mods that are not compatible, post and I can see if I can update the compatibility

Manifest.Name: 鸭科夫宠物
Manifest.Description: 每日可反复互动并打开宠物专属储物箱；在皮埃尔商店购买两次宠物背包扩容。
Manifest.Author: Alice
